description: Returns the NFL regular-season schedule: week, home and away teams, kickoff time (UTC), status and final score, for a season, one week or one team (with that team's bye week). Use it for "who plays whom", kickoff times and results. Basic plan and above; Pro keys also get each game's betting line (spread_home, over_under, moneylines, implied team points).

season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.
season.title: Season

team.description: Only this team's games (also returns its bye week). Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

week.description: Only this week, 1-18. Default: the whole season.
week.title: Week

name: get_schedule

bye_week.description: The team's bye week (only when team is given).

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

games.description: Per game: week, home, away, kickoff (UTC), status, final score, and odds on Pro.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

odds.description: Below Pro only: a note that betting lines need Pro.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

updated_at.description: When the schedule was last refreshed.

title: NFL schedule and scores
